rows.title: The `/model` picker now lists models from your gateway's `/v1/models` endpoint when `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` points at an Anthropic-compatible gateway
rows.rationale: The sealed gateway discovery row retains both the authenticated model-list sentinel and the source path that adds discovered models to the picker.

rows.title: - Added `claude project purge [path]` to delete all Claude Code state for a project (transcripts, tasks, file history, config entry) — supports `--dry-run`, `-y/--yes`, `-i/--interactive`, and `--all`

sourceAssertions.fragment: export async function findProjectDirs(projectPath: string): Promise<string[]> {

rows.rationale: The sealed purge command, directory enumeration, and warning-helper rows retain the command surface and its reviewed deletion-support source.

rows.title: `--dangerously-skip-permissions` now bypasses prompts for writes to `.claude/`, `.git/`, `.vscode/`, shell config files, and other previously-protected paths (catastrophic removal commands still prompt as a safety net)
rows.rationale: The sealed permission row retains the bypass safety-net witness that continues to require approval for catastrophic recursive directory removal.

rows.title: `claude auth login` now accepts the OAuth code pasted into the terminal when the browser callback can't reach localhost (WSL2, SSH, containers)
rows.rationale: The sealed OAuth row retains the terminal paste fallback used when the localhost browser callback cannot complete.

rows.title: `claude_code.skill_activated` OpenTelemetry event now fires for user-typed slash commands and carries a new `invocation_trigger` attribute (`"user-slash"`, `"claude-proactive"`, or `"nested-skill"`)
rows.rationale: The sealed skill telemetry row retains the invocation-trigger bundle sentinel and the reviewed activation-recording callsite.

rows.title: Auto mode: the spinner now turns red when a permission check stalls, instead of looking like the tool is running
rows.rationale: The sealed tool-execution row retains the post-permission in-progress transition that keeps a stalled permission check out of the running-tool state.

rows.title: Host-managed deployments (`CLAUDE_CODE_PROVIDER_MANAGED_BY_HOST`) no longer auto-disable analytics on Bedrock/Vertex/Foundry
rows.rationale: The sealed settings/runtime row retains the host-managed provider branch used to preserve deployment-controlled analytics behavior.

rows.title: Windows: PowerShell 7 installed via the Microsoft Store, MSI without PATH, or `.NET global tool` is now detected
rows.rationale: The sealed Windows terminal row retains the reviewed PowerShell probing path for installations outside the ordinary PATH search.

rows.title: Windows: when the PowerShell tool is enabled, Claude now treats PowerShell as the primary shell instead of defaulting to Bash

sourceAssertions.fragment: return 'Shell: PowerShell (use PowerShell syntax — e.g., $null not /dev/null, $env:VAR not $VAR, backtick for line continuation). Bash is also available via the Bash tool for POSIX scripts.'

rows.rationale: The sealed command/UI row retains the system prompt that identifies PowerShell as the primary Windows shell while keeping Bash available.

rows.title: Read tool: removed the per-file malware-assessment reminder that could cause spurious refusals and "this is not malware" commentary on legacy models

rows.rationale: Authenticated semantic clusters C002, C003 bind exact adjacent-bundle witnesses to the reviewed source owners and focused active-semantics, semantic-delta verification.

rows.title: **Security:** Fixed `allowManagedDomainsOnly` / `allowManagedReadPathsOnly` being ignored when a higher-priority managed-settings source lacked a `sandbox` block
rows.rationale: The sealed settings/runtime row retains both managed-domain and managed-read-path aggregation across every policy tier.

rows.title: Fixed pasting an image larger than 2000px breaking the session — images are now downscaled on paste, and oversized images in history are automatically removed and the request retried

sourceAssertions.fragment: `Removed oversized image at messages.${oversizedImage.messageIdx}.content.${oversizedImage.contentIdx} (exceeded 2000px many-image limit); retrying.`,

rows.rationale: The sealed image/retry row retains dimension-aware resizing and the targeted retry removal of an oversized historical image.

rows.title: Fixed showing the login screen for "OAuth not allowed for organization" errors — now shows guidance to contact your admin

sourceAssertions.fragment: 'Your organization has disabled Claude subscription access for Claude Code · Use an Anthropic API key instead, or ask your admin to enable access'

rows.rationale: The sealed OAuth row retains the organization-policy error classification and its administrator guidance instead of routing to login.

rows.title: Fixed OAuth login failing with timeout on slow or proxied connections, in IPv6-only devcontainers, and when the browser callback can't reach localhost
rows.rationale: The sealed OAuth row retains the explicit loopback listener and extended client timeout used by slow, proxied, and callback-limited environments.

rows.title: Fixed a rare race where a concurrent credential write could clear a valid OAuth refresh token
rows.rationale: The sealed settings/runtime row retains the locked refresh-token identity used to avoid clearing a concurrently replaced valid credential.

rows.title: Fixed API retry countdown sticking at "0s" instead of counting down between attempts
rows.rationale: The sealed tool/runtime row retains deadline-based retry countdown calculation, preventing a stale zero-second display between attempts.

rows.title: Fixed "Stream idle timeout" error after waking Mac from sleep mid-request / Fixed background and remote sessions falsely aborting with "Stream idle timeout" during long model thinking pauses
rows.rationale: Authenticated semantic clusters C001, C006 bind exact adjacent-bundle witnesses to the reviewed source owners and focused active-semantics, semantic-delta verification.

rows.title: Fixed a hang where the assistant could finish thinking but show no output after a run of empty turns
rows.rationale: The sealed message-rendering row retains the per-turn replacement-text guard that keeps assistant text visible instead of leaving a blank turn.

rows.title: Fixed overly fast trackpad scrolling in Cursor and VS Code 1.92–1.104 integrated terminals
rows.rationale: The sealed terminal row retains the affected Cursor and VS Code wheel-flood version window and its corrected scroll configuration.

rows.title: Fixed claude.ai MCP connectors being suppressed by manual servers stuck in needs-auth state
rows.rationale: The sealed MCP/OAuth row retains the credential-state distinction used to avoid suppressing valid managed connectors behind stale manual servers.

rows.title: Fixed Japanese/Korean/Chinese text rendering as garbled characters on Windows in no-flicker mode
rows.rationale: The sealed command/UI row retains the terminal-state reset added when leaving the attached no-flicker terminal surface on Windows.

rows.title: Fixed `Ctrl+L` clearing the prompt input — it now only forces a screen redraw, matching readline behavior
rows.rationale: This byte-identical target-retained behavior repairs an inherited source gap that the sealed 2.1.124 direct catalog did not project; it is not part of the adjacent active bundle delta.

targetRetainedSourceRepair.observedBehavior: Both adjacent bundles bind Ctrl+L to chat:clearInput, whose callback only increments redraw state, updates the shortcut reference, and invokes the fullscreen double-press helper; recovered source now preserves that redraw-only prompt behavior.

rows.title: Fixed deferred tools (WebSearch, WebFetch, etc.) not being available to skills with `context: fork` and other subagents on their first turn
rows.rationale: The sealed tool-execution row retains first-turn deferred-tool attachment propagation for forked skills and subagents.

rows.title: Fixed plan-mode tools being unavailable in interactive sessions launched with `--channels`
rows.rationale: The sealed tool-execution row retains the interactive-session guard that no longer removes plan-mode tools merely because channels are configured.

rows.title: Fixed blank remote-session transcript when certain messaging tools are unavailable
rows.rationale: The sealed message and SDK rows retain both origin propagation on terminal results and channel-origin visibility in remote transcripts.

rows.title: Fixed `/plugin` Uninstall reporting "Enabled" instead of "Uninstalled"
rows.rationale: The sealed plugin row retains the operation guard that prevents a successful uninstall from being reported through the enabled path.

rows.title: Bounded total size of file-modified reminders when a linter touches many files at once
rows.rationale: The sealed attachment row retains the aggregate edited-file snippet budget that bounds linter-generated file-modified reminders.

rows.title: Fixed `/remote-control` retries appearing stuck on "connecting…" — each retry now shows its result, and unenrolled trusted-device failures are caught up-front
rows.rationale: The sealed Remote Control rows retain per-attempt result details and the up-front trusted-device enrollment failure check.

rows.title: Fixed Remote Control failure notification not showing the error reason for initial connection failures
rows.rationale: The sealed Remote Control rows retain the explicit initial error state and the reviewed reason surfaced for trusted-device failures.

rows.title: Windows: clipboard writes no longer expose copied content in process command-line arguments visible to EDR/SIEM telemetry; also fixes >22KB selections not reaching the clipboard
rows.rationale: The sealed Windows terminal row retains stdin-based PowerShell clipboard transport, keeping copied contents out of process arguments.

rows.title: PowerShell tool: bare `--` (e.g. `git diff -- file`) is no longer mis-flagged as the `--%` stop-parsing token
rows.rationale: The sealed PowerShell parser witness retains exact stop-parsing-token recognition without treating a bare double dash as that token.

rows.title: Fixed Agent SDK hang when the model emits a malformed tool name in a parallel tool call batch
rows.rationale: The sealed streaming-tool row retains one-pass tracking of results actually yielded before a blocked item, preventing an already completed malformed parallel tool from causing a busy loop.

rows.title: Effort changes persist to user settings before local side effects
rows.rationale: Authenticated semantic clusters C004 bind exact adjacent-bundle witnesses to the reviewed source owners and focused active-semantics, semantic-delta verification.
